First run
Start by depositing a yield-bearing asset. Continua will separate your principal from its future yield and show each future period as a tradable strip.
How it works
A deposit is separated into four future yield periods and principal. Each period trades on its own; principal keeps its own dollar value and rolls forward automatically.

Continuing claim
{{ prinRollNote }}
Figure. Principal / ∞ is the continuing asset claim. It sits beyond the visible curve and automatically rolls forward to mint the next yield period.
What each side is trading
Buying principal
Buying the continuing claim that keeps generating future strips. There is no maturity and nothing to roll by hand — the position mints the next period itself.
Selling principal
Selling that continuing claim while retaining any strips you already own. Their claim dates are unchanged; you simply stop minting new periods.
